name: Discordance

description.content: Within [128m] of you, whenever a Generator is being repaired by at least [2] Survivors, you are alerted.
While that Generator is being repaired by at least [2] Survivors, you see its Aura. When it is no longer being repaired by at least [2[ Survivors, this ends after [4s].

quote: Smartasses get killed. We always see to that." -The Legion
